title: Respiratory-band RR peak concentration does not establish incremental AF-detection benefit beyond temporal and spectral summaries
abstract: In AFDB-to-LTAFDB transfer, adding respiratory-band RR spectral peak concentration to eleven temporal/spectral descriptors changed equal-record log loss by -0.00005602; source-refit/target-record bootstrap95% interval [-0.01067, 0.01868] does not establish incremental benefit. Existing-public-data external evaluation:2687 source windows/25 recordings and17623 target windows/83 eligible recordings. Temporal/spectral baseline, quality checks and flexible-model challenges do not establish incremental utility. Prior target exposure limits confirmation. AI-authored; author checks are not peer review.
